messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
URGENT: Billing portal privacy breach / wrong data shown

This is ridiculous! I tried updating our credit card on the billing portal for our subscription invoice, and suddenly an error flashed on the screen showing another practice's payment profile and account details. This is a massive privacy breach and I am furious that financial and patient data is getting crossed. Fix this immediately and explain how this happened.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I’m very sorry to hear about the issue you experienced with the billing portal and understand how concerning this must be.

A member of our support team is now reviewing the details of the incident. We take privacy and data security very seriously and will investigate this matter thoroughly.

We will keep you updated as we work through the investigation.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
